tooltip.randomthings.rainbow_lamp: Changes color based on redstone signal
tooltip.randomthings.block_of_sticks_ret: Returns to nearest player after 10 seconds
tooltip.randomthings.biome_stone: The color of these stone variants changes depending on the biome they are in
tooltip.randomthings.biome_glass: Translucent glass that changes color based on the biome
tooltip.randomthings.lapis_glass: Solid for players, but other entities pass through
tooltip.randomthings.biome_crystal: You find Biome Crystals in dungeon chests, they can be used to craft biome blocks
tooltip.randomthings.block_breaker: Breaks blocks in front of it and puts drops in inventories behind it. Can be controlled with redstone.
tooltip.randomthings.block_destabilizer: Makes connected blocks fall when powered by redstone. Has configurable lazy and fuzzy modes.
tooltip.randomthings.iron_dropper: An advanced configurable Dropper. You can change the pickup delay of items dropped, whether the dropper spits the items out "perfectly straight" (Nice for Superlubricent Ice/Stone), whether there are any particles/sound effects & how it reacts to redstone.
tooltip.randomthings.chat_detector: Outputs redstone signal when the owner sends a specific chat message
tooltip.randomthings.global_chat_detecto: Outputs redstone signal when any player sends a specific chat message. Requires ID Card for message consumption.
tooltip.randomthings.id_card: Right-click to bind to yourself. Used by Global Chat Detector for message consumption.
tooltip.randomthings.compressed_slime_bl: Bounces entities upward. Right-click with shovel to compress further (up to 3 levels)
tooltip.randomthings.contact_button: Activate by right-clicking the block it's facing. Provides temporary redstone signal like a button.
tooltip.randomthings.contact_lever: Activate by right-clicking the block it's facing. Toggles redstone signal like a lever.
tooltip.randomthings.diaphanous_block: Changes opacity based on distance to player. Can mimic any block's appearance. Default version has no collision and vanishes when close. Inverted version has collision and appears when close.
tooltip.randomthings.fluid_display: Right-click with fluid container to display fluid texture. Right-click to toggle flowing/still. Shift+right-click to rotate.
tooltip.randomthings.igniter: Ignites blocks in front when powered by redstone. Has 3 modes: Toggle Fire, Ignite, Keep Ignited.
tooltip.randomthings.inventory_tester: Simulates inserting items into adjacent inventories. Emits redstone signal based on success. Redstone behavior can be inverted.
gui.randomthings.block_destabilizer.lazy: Lazy Mode: Remembers the shape from the last operation for faster subsequent runs
gui.randomthings.block_destabilizer.fuzz: Fuzzy Mode: Only cares about block type, not exact state (e.g., Oak Wood Planks vs Wood Planks)
gui.randomthings.block_destabilizer.rese: Reset: Clears the remembered shape for lazy mode
tooltip.randomthings.iron_dropper.redsto:
Pulse:
Drop one item when receiving
a redstone pulse

Repeat Powered:
Continuously drop items while
powered by redstone

Repeat:
Continuously drop items
regardless of redstone state
tooltip.randomthings.iron_dropper.pickup:
No pickup delay:
Items can be picked up
immediately

5 tick pickup delay:
Items cannot be picked up
for 5 ticks after dropping

20 tick pickup delay:
Items cannot be picked up
for 20 ticks after dropping
tooltip.randomthings.iron_dropper.random:
Exact motion:
Items are ejected with
precise, consistent velocity

Random motion:
Items are ejected with
random velocity and trajectory
tooltip.randomthings.iron_dropper.effect:
No effects:
Silent and invisible dropping

Sound only:
Plays dispensing sound
when dropping items

Particles only:
Shows particle effects
when dropping items

Both sound and particles:
Full audio and visual effects
when dropping items
